lines.text: You already know what it feels like to try your hardest all night and still come up with nothing.
Peter was that tired, washing out nets he never wanted to touch again, in front of the very crowd watching him fail.
Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
Nevertheless at thy word, I will let down the net.
The net came up so full it started to break, and both boats began to sink under everything it couldn't hold.
Whatever you tried and lost, try again at His word. In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Nevertheless at Thy Word
story: A three-scene illustrated short film on Luke 5: a weary fisherman slumped over an empty net at grey dawn, a boat pushed out into brightening teal water as Jesus says launch into the deep, and a gold sunrise catch so large the net begins to tear and the boats begin to sink under it.
